result.description: FYG Automotive Pty Ltd  The successful applicant will be responsible for carrying out duties consistent with the occupation of  Motor Mechanic under ANZSCO 321211 , including:   Duties and Responsibilities    Detecting and diagnosing mechanical and electrical faults in engines and motor vehicle parts using diagnostic tools, test equipment and technical manuals.   Inspecting vehicles to identify faults, damage, wear and defects in engines, transmissions, suspension, steering, braking and other vehicle systems.   Dismantling and removing engine assemblies, transmissions, steering mechanisms and other components for inspection and repair.   Repairing and replacing worn, defective or damaged parts, including engines, transmissions, suspension, brakes, clutches, gearboxes and other mechanical components.   Reassembling engines and mechanical components after repair, ensuring they are restored to proper working condition.   Performing scheduled servicing and preventative maintenance, including oil changes, filter replacements, fluid checks, brake inspections and safety checks.   Testing and adjusting mechanical parts after repair to ensure proper performance and compliance with safety standards.   Tuning engines and ensuring vehicles operate efficiently and safely.   Using electronic diagnostic equipment to test vehicle systems and identify faults.   Conducting road tests and final inspections to confirm vehicles are safe and roadworthy.   Maintaining accurate records of repairs, servicing, parts used and work performed.   Ensuring all work is carried out in accordance with manufacturer specifications, workplace procedures and occupational health and safety requirements.   Liaising with customers and workshop staff regarding repair requirements, servicing needs and estimated completion times where required.   Keeping tools, equipment and the workshop area clean, organised and safe.    Applicants must have relevant trade qualifications, such as a  Certificate III in Light Vehicle Mechanical Technology  or equivalent, and relevant practical experience as a Motor Mechanic. The ideal candidate will have strong diagnostic skills, sound knowledge of vehicle repair and servicing procedures, attention to detail, the ability to work independently and as part of a team, and a commitment to workplace health and safety.  This is a genuine full-time opportunity with FYG Automotive in regional NSW, offering a salary between  $76,515 and $85,000 plus superannuation , depending on skills and experience.   To apply , please submit your resume and evidence of relevant qualifications and experience.     About Company       FYG Automotive is seeking a qualified and experienced  Motor Mechanic  to join our busy automotive workshop in West Wyalong, NSW. This is a full-time position suitable for a reliable and skilled mechanic who can diagnose, repair and maintain a wide range of motor vehicles.
